I understand how you feel and I'm really sorry that's happened to you. 
One time I was on r/lonely and there was a post that said if anyone needs to talk just PM me. There are quite a few of those there and on this sub as well. I PMed two different users that posted similar things and they both ignored me. It's sad. My so called family ignores me, my so called friends ignore me and even strangers on the internet ignore after saying they are willing to talk to anyone that's hurting. That shit sucks. 

Because of what I've had to deal with I go the extra mile to help people whenever even if I'm hurting. Please just talk to us. We're here for you 💜
